# Google Arts & Culture

> > A digital platform bringing art, history, and cultural heritage from museums and institutions worldwide through interactive experiences, AR technology, and AI-powered discovery tools.

Google Arts & Culture partners with museums and cultural organizations globally to digitize collections, offering features like Art Selfie (matching selfies to artwork), Art Transfer, Pocket Galleries, and 3D/AR models of artifacts, planets, and cultural heritage sites. The platform spans art, geography, space exploration, and world history.

## Key Topics

- Art Selfie
- Art Transfer
- Pocket Galleries
- Augmented Reality (AR)
- Museum Collections
- Cultural Heritage
- 3D Models
- Artwork Matching
- Art Discovery
- Cartography
- World Geography
- Space Exploration
- Interactive Experiences
- Digital Preservation
- Camera Features

## Interactive Camera Features

- [Camera — Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com/camera/selfie): Art Selfie camera feature matches selfies with artwork from museums

## Geography & Cultural Heritage

- [World Political Map — Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com/asset/world-political-map/4gFbpjL2N5Xc7Q?hl=en): World Political Map showing cultural heritage across continents

## Space & Science

- [Jupiter — Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com/asset/jupiter/KwFv1lcXm-dE1w?hl=en): 3D model of Jupiter gas giant planet with AR viewing
